title: ICC prosecution seeks to use 3 more recorded testimonies in Duterte case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution in former President Rodrigo Duterte’s crimes against humanity case before the International Criminal Court (ICC) is again seeking to admit as evidence the pre-recorded testimonies of three more witnesses. Based on a 10-page copy of the prosecution’s application made public on Tuesday (Manila time), the panel said the recorded testimonies of the three witnesses, identified as “P-1097,” “P-1170,” and “P-1318” were relevant as it provides evidence on the Philippine National Police’s (PNP) role in the implementation of Duterte’s bloody campaign against illegal drugs, as well as the former president’s individual criminal responsibility.
